title: Chapter 68: The Frustration Of Living Under Someone Else'S Roof
content:
Chapter 68: The Frustration Of Living Under Someone Else'S Roof

Along the way, except for seeing a few alliance territories, the rest of the land was completely uninhabited. The Tengu clan's policy of clearing out the wilderness was implemented very well.

Ahead, we entered the territory directly under the Tengu clan, which was the destination of this alliance army's expedition.

The territory in this area is dense, and it is one of the many battlefields chosen by the Tengu clan for a decisive battle with the army of the evil god camp.

As a major clan in the local camp, the Tengu clan's sphere of influence is very large. The area where Wu Qing is currently located is only a corner of their sphere of influence.

The grand battle that the alliance army is going to participate in is just an insignificant point in the battle between the two camps. There are countless large battlefields of different sizes that together form the battle line between the camps.

This was the general trend Meng told Wu Qing, which gave Wu Qing a conceptual understanding of the conflict between camps in this world.

"Let's go! Let's go back first!"

Arriving at his own territory, the young master of the Tengu tribe suddenly regained his energy and called on the cavalry behind him to speed up and run away, regardless of the more than 20,000 alliance troops he brought with him.

"what to do?"

Yu Chong asked with a helpless smile.

"What else can we do? We just pretend we don't know what that kid is and just rush in!"

"They were rude first, then we won't be polite!"

"Wu Qing said that he has no intention of taking back the Zerg troops he brought out!"

"Everyone, be tough! Just do it when things happen! We are not afraid of intrigues!"

Now that Wu Qing has revealed his secrets, Meng is now very tough.

Coming here as an alliance, encountering all kinds of difficulties, and falling into all kinds of conspiracies and tricks, that is a sure thing. Instead of compromising, it is better to fight vigorously!

The Tengu clan will not be stupid enough to fight against the Alliance first. As long as they still want the Alliance army to fight the enemy, they will have room for maneuver.

As for going to the battlefield, no matter how difficult the environment is, the Zerg are not afraid!

The troops of the Tengu Clan patrolling the outside had already discovered the arrival of the Alliance army. They didn't know what the young master of the Tengu Clan who left first told them. Those patrol teams did not send anyone to contact them, but just observed from a distance.

"Organize the team!"

"Take a minute's rest!"

"Prepare all to charge!"

Meng issued an order to prepare for a charge to five thousand elite troops.

The Zerg puppies gathered densely in front of the army, baring their teeth and claws, looking to choose and devour anyone. Their ferocious aura made the patrol team not far away feel a little bad.

"Get ready to charge behind the Zerg!"

"Charge as much as you want! But don't kill anyone! Hahaha!"

Meng shouted orders and raised the sword in his hand.

Under Wu Qing's order, the Zerg puppies rushed towards the territory of the Tengu clan like water from a dam.

"Ugh...!"

The patrol team blew a low horn, which was a signal that the territory was under attack from foreign enemies!

"Haha! These are really a bunch of fools! Let's see how you end up!"

"Wu Qing! Don't be afraid! If any of them dare to take action, I will kill them!"

As soon as Meng arrived at the battlefield environment, he seemed very excited.

The fierce tiger took the lead and rushed to the front. He shouted loudly: "We are the alliance army coming to support!"

"The team responsible for responding is right in front! We have to speed up and follow!"

"Who dares to stop me! Don't blame me for being ruthless!"

He suddenly turned on his big "trumpet", and the sound was like rolling spring thunder, making people's ears buzz.

The horn sounded, and the troops were quickly gathering in the barracks scattered in the nearby territory.

This movement is quite big!

The patrol team heard the fierce shouting. Facing such a large army, and it was also a friendly army, they did not dare to stop them. If they rushed forward, they would die in vain.

"You're going to be hurt badly now!"

The young general who led the patrol realized the seriousness of the problem.

The patrols remained motionless and unattacked, as the Alliance army roared past them.

The alliance army fiercely pursued the young master of the Tengu tribe. No matter what the young master was going to do, he was still acting as the messenger and running with him. There was nothing wrong with it. If the matter got serious, there was a way to explain it.

If the young master of the Tengu Clan is allowed to leave today and the alliance army is left here, who knows what kind of things he will do.

Wu Qing didn't have time to play such tricks with him.

That day, the son of the Dog Clan heard the horns blown by the patrol team and saw the Alliance army charging towards him like a battle. For a moment, his mind seemed to be filled with mush and he lost his ability to think.

Faced with such a result, he couldn't tell whether he wanted to be happy or afraid.

As a large clan, the Tengu clan has a very deep foundation. Soon after the warning horn sounded, a vanguard force rushed towards this position.

All came were the Tengu clan cavalry, led by a tall Tengu clan general with a spear in hand and an extraordinary temperament.

The small number of Tengu cavalry blocked the front of the charging army.

"Which troops are attacking the territory?! Stop immediately!"

Finally seeing normal people coming out, Wu Qing asked the Zerg to stop charging, and the Alliance army slowly stopped.

Meng brought Wu Qing, Yu Chong, and Bai Yan to the front of the army and faced the Tengu clan general.

"We are reinforcements from the Independent Territory Alliance! It was the front-line support team that led our charge. We thought there was a war ahead!"

Meng replied with a cold face and dissatisfaction.

The tall general of the Tengu tribe turned his head and glanced at the young man who was standing aside and in a state of confusion.

"That's a misunderstanding. Since it's reinforcements, I will send someone to settle you."

The general of the Tengu tribe said lightly, and signaled the people behind him to send a signal to cancel the warning.

"You just stand by where you are! Follow the arrangements!"

The general of the Tengu tribe left some cavalry to be on guard, and he turned and left. At this time, the young man of the Tengu tribe also came back to his senses and left with a happy face.

"TM! We have done useless work!"

"We are left here again!"

"It's so frustrating!"

Meng couldn't help but swear.

After marching for more than three hours and making a surprise charge, they just wanted to make things bigger and take the initiative.

Now a vanguard general came and revealed the matter in one sentence without even asking.

Looking at the current situation, I don't know how long the more than 20,000 troops of the alliance will be left here.

If it were an ordinary army, it would be almost finished if it was dealt with like this.

"This is what it's like to live under someone else's roof, think positively!"

"Don't worry, they will send us out to fight soon!"

Wu Qing smiled and comforted.

"I really admire you for being able to laugh at this time!"

Meng gave Wu Qing a thumbs up.
